说明: 在集中云测执行期间继续准备后续差异修复的原始基线：执行锁定原版五个公开 getter 的缺省／null／空白／标量与容器转换，不改 Swift 模型，不把原版观察当成本项目兼容通过。
observedContracts: Absent and null yield Java null; default original Gson omits the null key.
Empty text and whitespace, including CRLF and U+2003, remain text rather than missing.
Original StringJsonDeserializer converts true to Java String true and the exact raw numeric token 1e3 to Java String 1e3.
Objects and arrays become compact JSON text.
An explicit serializeNulls clone retains declared null fields; this diagnostic variant is distinct from the default original Gson output.
limits: Reference execution covers one actual public nullable String getter per original model and eight fixed wire forms. It does not prove every field or rule execution protocol.
Only the original Kotlin/Gson model serializers were executed; no Swift code, iOS tests, source network operations or reader UI were exercised.
Parcelable/Parcelize are empty platform-only stubs. The eight original Kotlin sources are byte-identical to the pinned ZIP.
serializeNulls output is an explicit Gson diagnostic variant. It is not a claim that the original application exports using serializeNulls.
Old Swift safeString normalization and ContentRule.callBackJs empty-to-nil behavior are not changed or validated by this reference fixture.
Numeric 1e3 is retained as an exact raw JSON token before Gson conversion; no Python numeric parse/re-encoding is used to construct that wire value.
nextAcceptance: Use these typed original values and raw wire tokens to design specific Swift preservation fixes without changing unrelated reader routes; compare actual Swift runtime output before declaring parity.
